entries.title: Ephesians 3:1
segments: ¶For this reason *I* Paul, prisoner of the Christ Jesus for you nations,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:2
segments: (if indeed ye have heard of the administration of the grace of God which has been given to me towards you,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:3
segments: that by revelation the mystery has been made known to me, (according as I have written before briefly,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:4
segments: by which, in reading it, ye can understand my intelligence in the mystery of the Christ,)

entries.title: Ephesians 3:5
segments: which in other generations has not been made known to the sons of men, as it has now been revealed to his holy apostles and prophets in [the power of the] Spirit,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:6
segments: that [they who are of] the nations should be joint heirs, and a joint body, and joint partakers of [his] promise in Christ Jesus by the glad tidings;

entries.title: Ephesians 3:7
segments: of which I am become minister according to the gift of the grace of God given to me, according to the working of his power.

entries.title: Ephesians 3:8
segments: To me, less than the least of all saints, has this grace been given, to announce among the nations the glad tidings of the unsearchable riches of the Christ,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:9
segments: and to enlighten all [with the knowledge of] what is the administration of the mystery hidden throughout the ages in God, who has created all things,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:10
segments: in order that now to the principalities and authorities in the heavenlies might be made known through the assembly the all-various wisdom of God,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:11
segments: according to [the] purpose of the ages, which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:12
segments: in whom we have boldness and access in confidence by the faith of him.

entries.title: Ephesians 3:13
segments: Wherefore I beseech [you] not to faint through my tribulations for you, which is your glory.

entries.title: Ephesians 3:14
segments: ¶For this reason I bow my knees to the Father [of our Lord Jesus Christ],

entries.title: Ephesians 3:15
segments: of whom every family in [the] heavens and on earth is named,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:16
segments: in order that he may give you according to the riches of his glory, to be strengthened with power by his Spirit in the inner man;

entries.title: Ephesians 3:17
segments: that the Christ may dwell, through faith, in your hearts, being rooted and founded in love,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:18
segments: in order that ye may be fully able to apprehend with all the saints what [is] the breadth and length and depth and height;

entries.title: Ephesians 3:19
segments: and to know the love of the Christ which surpasses knowledge; that ye may be filled [even] to all the fulness of God.

entries.title: Ephesians 3:20
segments: But to him that is able to do far exceedingly above all which we ask or think, according to the power which works in us,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:21
segments: to him be glory in the assembly in Christ Jesus unto all generations of the age of ages. Amen).
